_source: Gui.vb (statOffsetX/Y, statWidth 96 x statHeight 48, iFPSProfileSpeed 100, initFont), Engine.vb renderDisplay and oneFrameRender's pause, Root.vb (colorReticle = Red; bDrawFPS True at the start and in every Reset). Positions are pixels of the original's 512 x 448 window (Form1.vb; the pause banner sits at 512 / 2, 448 / 2), y down; colours are Write's [alpha, red, green, blue]; fontSize is points (fontMenu Arial 10 bold, fontPause Arial Narrow 24). anchor is TopLeft, TopRight (x pixels in from the right edge: rTarget.Width - 50) or Center.

port._about: Not in the original: the dim behind the pause banner, the game-over banner over the fade, and a thin drop shadow under the HUD text.
